title: What If Your Phone Caught Fire While Charging?
title_chip: WHAT IF YOUR PHONE CAUGHT FIRE?
end_cta: SEND THIS TO SOMEONE WHO CHARGES IN BED
lines: 2 a.m. Your phone starts smoking beside your pillow.
Under a pillow, its heat has nowhere to go.
Now it makes heat faster than it can lose it.
It can burst into flames without warning.
That smoke is toxic. Your selfies are not worth it.
Get out. Close the door behind you.
Call one one two from outside.
Tomorrow: charge on a hard table, not your bed.
Original charger. And never while you sleep.
Where's your phone charging right now? Bed or table?
Send this to someone who charges in bed!
